verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ElevenLabs Agents stores both transcripts and audio recordings with configurable retention, and provides searching/filtering across conversation history and data-extraction features, implying recordings/transcripts are accessible per call. However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents a dedicated API endpoint for programmatically pulling the full recording and transcript for every call. Missing for 10: explicit API/endpoint documentation for bulk/programmatic retrieval of call recordings and transcripts, and confirmation that this works for 'every call' at scale.
